notes_for_editor: One register page carries the tower facts. The statewide blog is context only. Two web searches (Early County tower; Georgia Forestry Commission history) returned no tower-specific pages, and local city and county history pages had no mention. Access, fire history and current owner are not in any source read, so they are left out of facts. Height 100 ft converted to 30.5 m. The record's 86 m elevation is the NHLR site elevation, not tower height. Story is at the low end of length because the evidence is thin.
